entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The golden age of Slovak mining towns: Kremnica mint (producing the famous golden ducats), Banská Štiavnica's silver mines, urban Magdeburg Law privileges, the University of Istropolitana in Bratislava (1465), and Matthias Corvinus's cultural influence.
